description: Associate entities or spatial regions with state-memory task DAGs (link/unlink), or extract goal-relevant spatial context slices.

action.description: Action to perform: "link" (default), "unlink", or "get_context" to retrieve goal-relevant spatial slice

current_agent_position.description: Current agent position for get_context action

max_entities.description: Maximum entities to return for get_context action (default: 20)

radius.description: Proximity radius around agent for get_context action (default: 30)

relationship.description: Role of entity relative to goal (default: target)

name: link_to_goal
